areas.gap: Render and act on response-quality results; add model-graded domain and citation-entailment benchmarks.

areas.label: Context and durable memory
areas.gap: Add provenance-aware memory summaries, migration failure reporting, and retrieval regression suites.

areas.label: Agent planning and recovery
areas.gap: Resume the exact interrupted tool step instead of returning the objective to the composer.

areas.label: Tools and connectors
areas.gap: Finish MCP initialization, discovery, per-tool approval, invocation UI, transport support, and authentication.

areas.label: Files and artifact production
areas.gap: Add live editing, preview diffs, and round-trip fidelity tests for every generated office format.

areas.label: Research and evidence
areas.gap: Revalidate every redirect and resolved address, preserve source links, and verify citations against page text.

areas.label: Image, audio, and video understanding
areas.gap: Use a dedicated vision permission and model selector; finish the external AMD video bundle and acceptance run.

areas.label: Reliability and self-repair
areas.gap: Exercise crash-loop recovery, clear timers on shutdown, and rehearse automatic last-known-good rollback.

areas.label: Ease of use and accessibility
areas.gap: Replace prompt-based setup with validated forms and add keyboard plus screen-reader end-to-end tests.

areas.label: Release and operations
areas.gap: Hash the packaged app, verify signatures in CI, obtain Developer ID, notarize, and test the installed bundle.

codeFindings.evidence: main.js:1424 follows redirects after validating only the initial URL.
codeFindings.work: Disable automatic redirects; validate every Location target and resolved IP before each bounded fetch.

codeFindings.evidence: scripts/generate-release-manifest.js hashes three source metadata files, not the packaged .app or app.asar.
codeFindings.work: Generate SHA-256 values after packaging for the app archive and app.asar; verify them before installation and in CI.

codeFindings.evidence: renderer.js registers an MCP endpoint but never calls listMcpTools, setMcpPermission, callMcpTool, removeMcpServer.
codeFindings.work: Build a typed MCP server/tool screen with initialize handshake, discovery, approval, invocation, disable, and removal.

codeFindings.evidence: main.js callMcp assumes every response is JSON although the Accept header includes text/event-stream.
codeFindings.work: Implement MCP Streamable HTTP/SSE framing, protocol initialization, timeouts, cancellation, and structured errors.

codeFindings.evidence: main.js attaches result.quality; renderer.js never reads result.quality.
codeFindings.work: Show quality evidence, allow review/retry, and keep low-confidence output from being presented as silently verified.

codeFindings.evidence: Coverage reports 95.98% only for imported modules; main.js, preload.js, renderer.js, and reference-studio.js are absent.
codeFindings.work: Add Electron integration tests that launch the packaged app and exercise every IPC, clear/restart, attachment, agent, and media journey.

codeFindings.evidence: agent-task-ledger.js resume changes status to understanding; renderer.js places the original objective back in the composer.
codeFindings.work: Persist the completed-step cursor, inputs, receipts, and compensation state; resume from the first incomplete step with the same idempotency key.

codeFindings.evidence: main.js analyzeLocalImage requires files.attach_local_text and silently chooses the first vision-capable model.
codeFindings.work: Create a dedicated local-vision permission, explicit model selection, configurable analysis instruction, and image-result evaluation.

codeFindings.evidence: Reference preview and state-load paths contain empty catch blocks that suppress actionable failures.
codeFindings.work: Record bounded diagnostics and show recoverable UI errors instead of silently dropping failed previews or migrations.

codeFindings.evidence: main.js is 1,875 lines/152 KB and renderer.js is 108 KB with many one-line functions.
codeFindings.work: Split provider, IPC, privacy, research, media, and renderer controllers into typed modules with dependency injection.

codeFindings.evidence: Overall branch coverage is 68.12%; web-evidence is 28.57%, provider-contract 36.36%, and extension-sdk 42.86%.
codeFindings.work: Raise branch coverage on network, credential, parsing, extension, and failure paths to at least 85%.

codeFindings.evidence: Release readiness reports no Apple Developer ID Application identity; current package is ad hoc signed.
codeFindings.work: Install the owner Developer ID certificate, notarize, staple, and verify with codesign and spctl before distribution.
